documentReading.enabled: Read the documents that arrive by WhatsApp
documentReading.recognitionHelp: For the AI: what the document is and how to tell it from another one. Write what is particular to your business, such as whose the destination account is. If the AI built the form from a received document, it wrote this text: review it.
documentReading.recognitionRequired: Write how to recognize the document.
documentReading.standardDataHelp: “Add” set which question receives each datum of “{{name}}”, version {{version}}, and it does not change. Renaming or moving a question does not stop the reading, and its validation is not turned off.
documentReading.question: Question

validations.bankAccount: Check digits of the CBU and the CVU
validations.taxId: Check digit of the CUIT or CUIL

documentReading.lookupsHelp: Fills a catalog question by looking up what was read in another question, such as the customer by the source CUIT. If it is not found, the question stays empty and the person chooses it.
documentReading.fieldsNeedRead: You need permission to read catalogs and see their fields.
documentReading.limit: You can add up to {{count}} lookups.
documentReading.noCatalogQuestions: There are no “Choose from a catalog” questions to fill.
documentReading.allFilled: Every “Choose from a catalog” question already has its lookup.
documentReading.incomplete: Choose the value read, the question it fills and what it is matched by.
documentReading.duplicatesHelp: If a repeated document arrives, it says when and in which response it was loaded, and it does not offer it again.
documentReading.duplicatesData: The same file, or one that matches in {{list}}.
documentReading.statsHelp: The documents confirmed in a response in the last 30 days and how much of what was read was confirmed without changes. The corrections do not go to the AI: they help you improve “How to recognize it”.
documentReading.loadError: We couldn't load how it is reading.
documentReading.noExamples: There were no corrections in the last 30 days.

locationContact.title: Location and contact
locationContact.help: The location or contact the person shares in the chat fills in these questions of the form they have open, and the form comes back to them filled in. With no question chosen, they stay in the chat.
locationContact.locationQuestion: The location goes to the “{{question}}” question, which is asked for before the form is sent.
locationContact.locationQuestionNumber: The location goes to question {{number}}, which is asked for before the form is sent.

issuance.title: Voucher
issuance.issuing: The voucher is being issued. The page updates on its own.
issuance.voidingCreditNote: The credit note is being issued. The page updates on its own.
issuance.voidingCancel: The issuance is being voided. The page updates on its own.
issuance.failedFix: Nothing was issued. Correct the response and the voucher goes out with the correction.
issuance.reviewOthers: Someone who can issue vouchers resolves it.
issuance.reviewChoice: What to do with the issuance
issuance.stopHelp: The response is voided, without a voucher.
issuance.awaiting: Waiting for you to confirm it
issuance.awaitingOthers: It waits for whoever loaded it to confirm it.
issuance.failed: The issuance of {{number}} could not be decided

done.retry: We try the issuance of {{number}} again.
done.issue: The voucher of {{number}} is being issued.

issuance.notAmendable: It has a voucher issued or in progress: void it and load another one.
issuance.voidDescription: A credit note for the total of the voucher of {{number}} is issued, which voids it. It cannot be undone.
issuance.creditNoteRequested: The credit note of {{number}} is being issued.

dashboard.addNone: Every chart is already on the dashboard.
dashboard.overflowNote: Some totals are too big to calculate and show “—”.
